Traits

Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Ash CloakWhile in ash or smoke, the wyrm has the Invisible condition to creatures that rely on sight.

Actions

MultiattackThe wyrm makes three Rend attacks.

RendMelee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

Ash Breath (Recharge 5–6)Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 49 (14d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

Bonus Actions

SmoulderThe wyrm's scales flare. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

Legendary Actions

Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the wyrm can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The wyrm regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Tail SweepMelee Attack Roll: +12, reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.

SmotherConstitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Sphere the wyrm can see within 90 feet. Failure: The target can't breathe until the end of its next turn.
